Title: Kerry Park
Note: The postcard. Skyline, Rainier behind it, Sound to the right. Tiny park, go at dusk.

Title: Gas Works Park
Note: Climb the mound. Downtown across Lake Union with seaplanes landing in front of it.

Title: Sky View Observatory
Note: 73rd floor of Columbia Center, the tallest public view in the city. Costs money, worth it once.

Title: Smith Tower Observatory
Note: 1914 open-air deck with a speakeasy attached. Lower than the Columbia Center and far more charming.

Title: Dr. Jose Rizal Park
Note: Beacon Hill. The skyline framed by the freeway, and almost never crowded.

Title: Hamilton Viewpoint Park
Note: West Seattle, looking straight down the throat of Elliott Bay at downtown.

Title: Volunteer Park Water Tower
Note: 106 steps up a brick tower for a free 360 of the city. Nobody tells visitors about it.

Title: Alki Beach Park
Note: The skyline from across the water, with sand under you. Sunset is the move.
